div.head: Wl ep 3.2
div.ab: Ille autem qui uocatus ad iustitiam episcopi uenire noluerit, pro unaquaque uocatione legem episcopalem emendabit.
Ille autem qui vocatus ad iusticiam episcopi venire noluerit, pro unaquaque vocatione legem episcopalem emendabit.
But he who, when summoned, refuses to appear before the bishop's court shall pay the (proper) fine for contempt of the bishop's authority for each time of summoning.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 236–237 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 485, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
